newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-AUSTRALIA'S BURKE OUT OF ALL BLACK CLASH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUSTRALIA'S BURKE OUT OF ALL BLACK CLASH.

text.p: Australia fullback Matt Burke suffered another injury setback on Tuesday when a persistent groin problem ruled him out of the return Tri-Nations test against New Zealand in Dunedin on August 16.
Burke, an automatic choice if fit, has endured a frustrating season, missing four of Australia's six tests to date because of the injury.
Stephen Larkham, who has proved an able deputy at fullback, will almost certainly keep his place.
Fly-half David Knox, the hero of Australia's 32-20 win against South Africa in Brisbane on Saturday, retained his place in a 23-man squad.
Knox interrupted a playing stint with Natal in South Africa's domestic Currie Cup after being summoned by Wallaby coach Greg Smith last week as a replacement for injured fly-half Tim Horan.
New Zealand head the Tri-Nations table with nine points from two games, four points clear of Australia. South Africa prop up the table with one point.
The All Blacks beat Australia 33-18 in the Tri-Nations match in Melbourne ten days ago, winning the Bledisloe Cup in the process.

Forwards - Andrew Blades, Marco Caputo, Matt Cockbain, Troy Coker, John Eales (captain), Owen Finegan, Michael Foley, Richard Harry, Andrew Heath, Daniel Manu, Garrick Morgan, Brett Robinson, David Wilson.
Backs - Elton Flatley, George Gregan, Mitch Hardy, James Holbeck, David Knox, Steve Larkham, Jason Little, Sam Payne, Joe Roff, Ben Tune.
